svg.title: DMAIC Studio database tables
svg.desc: Twenty SQLite tables in three groups. Accounts and settings: users, sessions, user_settings, site_settings. Projects and sharing: projects, owned by a user, and project_members. Project records: fifteen tables keyed by project_id, including phase entries, notes, process maps, and the Define phase tools.
svg.text: SQLite file /data/dmaic.sqlite · schema version 2 · foreign keys enforced · arrows point from the referencing column to the referenced key
Every table here has project_id → projects.id and is deleted with its project (ON DELETE CASCADE).
Users the owner shared the project with.
Orange: work items, notes, and process maps for every phase tab · Purple: Define phase tools
Dashed: segment and group links are cleared
when deleted; child CTQ nodes are deleted
